declarations.name: AuiConfig
declarations.description:
The configuration scope of the current injector. Inject it to read the effective
settings (`common()`), or to change the scope at run time (`set`, `patch`).

methods.name: set
methods.description: Replace this scope's own settings. Throws `AbsoluteUIError` on invalid values; the previous settings stay active.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Merge settings into this scope's own settings.

declarations.name: AuiDirectionality
declarations.description: Text direction of the current configuration scope.

methods.name: setProvider
methods.description: Resolve icon names through an icon library adapter (`null` restores the registry).

declarations.name: AuiIds
declarations.description:
Unique element ids. Ids are generated in creation order, so server rendering and
the client produce the same sequence for the same view tree.

methods.name: next
methods.description: The next unique id, for example `aui-3`.

declarations.name: AuiLocale
declarations.description: Locale settings of the current configuration scope.

declarations.name: AuiPlatform
declarations.description: Runtime capabilities. On the server, `window` is null and browser-only features report false.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Whether a browser API is available (always false on the server).

declarations.name: AuiTheme
declarations.description: Application theme, density, and animation mode (applied to the document element).

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Switch the application theme (a built-in name or one registered with `registerTheme`).

methods.name: setDensity
methods.description: Switch the density (compact, comfortable, or spacious) for this configuration scope.

methods.name: setAnimation
methods.description: Switch animations ('subtle' or 'none') for this configuration scope.

functions.name: provideAbsoluteUI
functions.description:
Application setup:
`bootstrapApplication(App, { providers: [provideAbsoluteUI({ timezone: 'Asia/Kolkata', components: { dataTable: { pageSize: 50 } } })] })`.
Optional: without it, components use their defaults. In a lazy route's providers it
creates a nested scope like `provideAbsoluteUIConfig`.

functions.name: provideAbsoluteUIConfig
functions.description:
A nested configuration scope for a route or component subtree:
`@Component({ providers: [provideAbsoluteUIConfig({ timezone: 'Europe/Berlin' })] })`.
Settings merge over the parent scope and apply to every AbsoluteUI component inside.
